pages.caption: Cover: John and an angel look at New Jerusalem in When God Makes Everything New.
John sees a new heaven, a new earth, and the holy city coming down from heaven.
A voice says God will live with his people. Tears, death, sadness, crying, and pain will be gone.
God says he is making everything new and offers the water of life for free. The page also gives his warning about the second death.
An angel shows John the shining city from a mountain and measures it with a gold rod.
John sees the beautiful stones, pearl gates, and clear gold of the city.
God gives the city light. Its gates stay open, and only those named in the book of life may enter.
The angel shows John the clear river of life and the tree of life with twelve kinds of fruit.
God's people will serve him, see his face, and have his light. The words of the book are true.
When John bows to the angel, the angel tells him to worship God and keep the book's words open.
Jesus promises to come soon. Those who do what God says may enter the city and eat from the tree of life.
The invitation says Come and offers the water of life for free. The book warns against adding or taking away words.
Jesus promises to come soon. The story ends with Come, Lord Jesus and a wish for his grace to be with all.
